'''Dalgos''' were four-legged animals native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]] used dalgos as beasts of burden and battle mounts during the [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|Battle of Onderon]].<ref name="AWOTF">{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}}</ref>
